title: West Nashville Nations Home close to downtown.
description: A home away from home. Memory foam mattresses deck out each bedroom and the couch is the perfect place to spread out. Our neighborhood is homy, but only 4 miles from downtown. The ease of access to the highway means you can get to the airport and any other part of Nashville without hassle.  The neighborhood itself is stacked with craft beer, neighborhood restaurants, and food for every time of day. The house is a crash pad for adventuring around the city, or a place that makes you feel local.
